evidence.V1: Classic anvil-on-stump outline (horn, face, waist, banded stump) reads from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette; A15 Y error 0.0 and the waist is centred over the stump.
evidence.V2: Big anvil + stump masses, medium waist foot and iron bands, small hardy hole and cream cut-face ring - clear layering.
evidence.V3: Anvil body is a straight-sided box with a plain cone horn and the stump a straight faceted cylinder with a slight flare; only partly stylised (no chunky taper, flared heel or chunky horn curve).
evidence.V4: Anvil face, waist and foot carry consistent chamfers that catch light, but the 12-sided stump has hard, unsoftened facet edges and the horn meets the body with an un-bevelled step.
evidence.V5: Stump shows stripe-like flat faceting in the studio close-ups and colourways, and the horn-to-body junction shows a pinched shading seam in close_horn_studio.
evidence.V6: Steel grey in two values for the anvil, wood brown stump, ink iron bands, cream cut face - disciplined.
evidence.V7: 1120 tris vs medium target 2000: under target.
evidence.V8: Kit palette and anvil chamfers match, but the visibly faceted low-segment stump departs from the smooth weighted-normal kit look.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, bottom-centre origin, MeshPart white with vertex colours.

artifacts: Visible flat faceting stripes on the 12-sided stump
Pinched shading / hard step where the cone horn meets the anvil body
top_fixes: Raise stump segments or smooth-shade it with weighted normals so it reads round, and add growth rings / bark lip for a stump read
Fuse the horn into the body with a curved transition and a slight upward sweep instead of a plain cone
Give the anvil body a flared heel and waisted taper so it reads less like a box primitive
